{"code":"        ratio = time_remaining / ttl

        # BUG_55: the guard should refresh when ratio is LOW
        # (close to expiry) instead of when ratio is HIGH (far from expiry)
        if ratio < self.threshold:
            self.refreshes_triggered += 1
            return True

        return False","comments":"Reverse the threshold comparison so entries only refresh when their remaining TTL ratio drops below the threshold, i.e., close to expiry."}
